home.faqLead: Find clear answers about the platform, its business tools, pricing and the ways you can get started.
home.faq1q: What is Bizuply and how does it work?
home.faq1a: Bizuply is a business management platform that brings customer management, supported marketing tools, WhatsApp Business communication, website creation, appointment scheduling and automations into a connected workspace. Businesses can choose the tools they need and organize daily activities around shared customer information and workflows.
home.faq2a: Bizuply is designed for small businesses, service providers, marketing teams and growing organizations that want to manage customer relationships and daily operations more efficiently. The available tools support different workflows, from lead follow-up and appointment scheduling to marketing activity and website management.
home.faq3q: What can I manage with Bizuply CRM?
home.faq3a: Bizuply CRM helps businesses organize leads and customer records, track pipeline stages, add notes and manage follow-up tasks. Teams can review customer details, update lead statuses and keep the information needed for the next interaction accessible.
home.faq4q: Can I manage Meta advertising campaigns through Bizuply?
home.faq4a: Bizuply provides supported Meta campaign management capabilities for connected business advertising accounts. Depending on account permissions and available features, businesses can review campaign activity, budgets and performance and work with incoming leads through their CRM processes. Advertising charges are billed separately by Meta.
home.faq5q: How does WhatsApp Business API work with Bizuply?
home.faq5a: Bizuply connects with the WhatsApp Business Platform so businesses can manage supported customer conversations and approved message templates from their workspace. The Bizuply subscription is $29 per month for each connected number. Meta messaging charges are separate and depend on message usage and applicable categories.
home.faq6q: Can I build a website or online store with Bizuply?
home.faq6a: Bizuply offers a visual website editor and ready-made templates that help businesses create and customize their online presence. Supported forms can connect inquiries with CRM workflows. Website setup services and store-related capabilities may have separate availability or pricing, depending on the selected service.
home.faq7q: What business processes can I automate?
home.faq7a: Bizuply supports workflows that respond to selected business events, such as lead activity or status changes. Depending on the available plan and configuration, businesses can use automation to create follow-up tasks and connect routine actions within their customer management processes.
home.faq8a: Yes. Bizuply includes appointment management tools for organizing services, availability and bookings. Businesses can review upcoming appointments, manage schedule changes and keep appointment information connected with their daily operations.
home.faq9q: Can Bizuply set up and manage services for my business?
home.faq9a: Yes. Businesses can use supported tools independently or request professional assistance with selected services, such as website setup, business workflows and digital configuration. The available setup services and their costs depend on the scope of work and the selected offering.
home.faq10a: Bizuply offers different plans and services depending on the tools a business needs. The CRM plan starts at $49 per month, while the Business plan is $99 per month or $990 per year. WhatsApp Business API is $29 per month per connected number, with Meta messaging charges billed separately. Visit the pricing page for current plans and service details.
home.finalTitle: Bring your business together with Bizuply
home.finalLead: Discover a more connected way to manage customers, marketing, communication and everyday work. Choose the tools that fit your business and start building a workspace around the way you operate.
home.supportLine: Whether you prefer to manage everything yourself or need expert help setting things up, Bizuply gives your business the tools and support to move forward.

Bizuply helps bring that information into your CRM, where you can organize the lead, manage conversations, schedule follow-ups and continue the customer journey.
